settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: txtCaster runs on this machine. Local by default; nothing leaves without your per-book choice.
settings.languageHint: Applies everywhere at once and stays after a restart.
settings.spotlightHint: Outlines what the tutor points at and dims the rest of the page.
settings.personalizeHint: The tutor remembers teaching preferences you state. Off stops using them without deleting them.
settings.memoryHint: Preferences you told the tutor. Forgetting one applies from your next session.
settings.memoryEmpty: Nothing yet. Tell the tutor how you like to learn, for example “start with examples.”
settings.neverPersistNote: Transcript retention is set to never persist, so the tutor already keeps preferences in memory only. This toggle takes effect again when retention allows saving.
settings.privacyUnreadableNote: These settings can’t be read right now. Until they can, the tutor keeps preferences in memory only and writes nothing.
settings.tutorPositionHint: For these books, tapping a figure or passage during a live tutor session tells the listed endpoint where you are looking. Revoking stops that immediately; the next tap asks again.
settings.cacheHint: Rebuildable working files. Stays beside the database.
settings.dirRefused: Using the default: {configured|ltr} was refused because {reason}.
settings.cacheLimitHint: Page images and segment audio count toward it; exported audio doesn't.
settings.capRefusedNotice: Using the default: {value|ltr} is not a whole number of bytes.
settings.capErrorShape: Use a plain number of GB, such as 20 or 7.5.
settings.capErrorNumber: Use a plain number of GB.
settings.capErrorZero: A cap of 0 GB is the No limit option.
settings.capErrorHuge: That size is larger than any disk.
settings.providersHint: Voice Tutor and cast provider keys now live together under Providers — pools, health, and per-key management in one place.
settings.supportHint: txtCaster is built and maintained independently. If it's useful to you, you can help keep it going through a Patreon membership. Everything keeps working either way.
settings.privacyHint: Nothing leaves without your per-book choice; no telemetry, no accounts
settings.moreControls: More controls — choosing these folders, overnight windows, hardware overrides — land here as the studio grows.
settings.updatesHint: txtCaster checks for new versions when it's online. Nothing installs until you choose to.
settings.updatesOffline: Couldn't reach the update service. We'll try again later.
settings.updatesUnavailable: Updates aren't set up in this build
settings.retentionHint: Kept only on this device. Never stops saving from your next session; saved ones stay until you delete them.
settings.reportIssueHint: Report bugs, request features, or view product releases.
settings.engineStorageHint: Local TTS and speech runtime binaries.
settings.cacheStorageHint: Temporary audio segments and synthesis files.
settings.dangerZoneHint: Permanently remove txtCaster, databases, all books, models, audio, caches, and desktop shortcuts from this machine.
settings.uninstallModalWarning: All local data will be permanently wiped: databases, book files, downloaded models, cached audio, application logs, desktop integration files, and the application itself. Nothing can be recovered.
settings.deleteModelModalWarning: Remove {name|bdi}? Model size: {size|ltr}. It will no longer be available offline. Download it again from Voices & Models to use it here. Any default using this model will be cleared. Saved audio is kept.
settings.uninstallEngineModalWarning: Are you sure you want to uninstall the local speech engine ({size|ltr})? Offline text-to-speech, transcription, and speech alignment will be unavailable until reinstalled. Cloud API generation will continue to work.
